question: How should the closed-form Jacobi-elliptic omega(t) and q(t) propagator be implemented and validated in phases?
narrative_md: DESIGN doc (not executed). Phased implementation plan for the closed-form Jacobi-elliptic propagator: s062a (eigendecompose m048 inertia + omega_jacobi via scipy.special.ellipj, validated vs DOP853 rtol < 1e-8), s062b (closed-form q(t) via theta-function Path 1 or precession+nutation Path 2, with a non-negotiable 3-gate round-trip validation), s062c (wire into lib/forward and profile), s062d (sample on polhode coords for the s061 reframe). Recommends Path 2 for debuggability and stresses not skipping the validation gate.
